method: match if (cited lines in same file within 8 lines AND token jaccard>=0.12) OR jaccard>=0.35; greedy per Claude claim. Heuristic, not semantic; unmatched claims need human read.

only_gemini.text: The analyzer avoids IndexOutOfRangeException by using FirstOrDefault() on DeclaringSyntaxReferences and safely handling properties without source declarations.
Diagnostics are only reported if their location is in source and belongs to the current compilation, ensuring no existing diagnostics for user-controlled types are lost or suppressed.

only_claude_texts.C2: For the same input the generator no longer throws (no CS8785) and a GeneratedMessagePackResolver is emitted.
only_claude_texts.C4: No diagnostic that was reported before the change for a type declared in source is lost, moved or changed by the new constructor-level filter.
only_claude_texts.C5: No safety-relevant diagnostic is silently dropped for types the user controls.
only_claude_texts.C8: Dropping a diagnostic that has no location in the compilation is required because analyzers are not permitted to report against a location that does not exist.
only_claude_texts.C9: No live DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] indexing remains in TypeCollector.cs; the only remaining occurrence is commented out.
only_claude_texts.C10: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation returns null only for properties that have no source declaration (metadata), so no source-declared property loses its diagnostic.
